blocklist.name: URL Blocklist
blocklist.description: Blocks connection to the sites listed in the filter list, defaults offer a safe and efficient set.

userscripts.name: Userscripts
userscripts.description: it really just loads files from a folder, userscripts is an overstatement

cssOverride.name: CSS Override
cssOverride.description: Appends the contents of Documents/glorp/css/style.css to the game's stylesheet (assets/style-XXXXX.css). Refresh the page to apply changes.

obsCapturePlugin.name: OBS Capture Plugin
obsCapturePlugin.description:
Installs Glorp Capture as a source into OBS. Requires OBS to be closed and may require administrator permission. 
 To record audio add an 'Application Audio capture and select the 'glorp audio window'

clearCache.name: Clear Cache & Storage
clearCache.description: Clears local storage, browser cache, and web data for the client
clearCache.buttonAction: if(confirm('Are you sure you want to clear cache and local storage?')) { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); window.chrome.webview.postMessage('clear-cache'); }

rawInput.name: Raw Input
rawInput.description: Lower latency, greater precision, fixes mouse flicks

gameFpsLimit.name: Game FPS Limit
gameFpsLimit.description:
The maximum FPS the game logic will run at 
0 = uncapped

renderFpsLimit.name: Present FPS Limit
renderFpsLimit.description:
The amount of frames that get presented to the screen 
always ≤ than the FPS outputted by the game 
displayed only with the 'Show Present FPS Counter' setting 
0 = uncapped

throttle.name: CPU Throttling
throttle.description:
Throttle CPU, value is the multiplier (2 is 50%), 
ONLY USE IF YOUR GAME EXPERIENCES INSTABILITY

inMenuThrottle.name: CPU Throttling in Menu
inMenuThrottle.description: Throttle CPU in menus, fixes an issue related to render FPS in menus

hardFlip.name: DXGI Swapchain Hook
hardFlip.description:
Hooks swapchain creation for frame pacing, the Present FPS limiter/counter and OBS capture. 
Turning it off can raise game FPS but disables those OBS features.

webviewPriority.name: Webview Priority
webviewPriority.description: Higher priority yields slightly better performance but might cause instabilities
